decisions.rationale_summary: Search for the registered treasury yield records to acquire evidence for required roles.
Query the first required public Finance record for 1996-01-09 to obtain its scalar value for normalization.

The previous query_structured_fact call failed because the required evidence definitions are unresolved. The public path condition requires search_then_structured, so search the archive for the relevant treasury yield series before querying structured facts.
Acquire the raw finance record for 1996-01-09 from the located archive document before normalizing it.

Need to locate the source record for the second required period (as of 1996-01-10) because only the first period record has been acquired. Search the archive to find the document locator, then open it to obtain the evidence for normalization.
Open the second required treasury yield record for 1996-01-10 found via search to obtain its observation value for the difference calculation.
Normalize the first evidence (1996-01-09) to its registered metric definition before computing the difference.
Normalize the second treasury yield observation (1996-01-10) to match the canonical metric definition so the difference can be computed.
Both normalization stages yielded values (5.41 and 5.50). The terminal calculation requires their difference.
Retry calculator with normalized operation references as operands to satisfy the terminal answer operation contract.
